title.it: I desideri: I wish, if only

rule.sl:
**wish** + preteklik za to, kar zdaj ni tako: **I wish I had a dog.** (Ko bi le {m:imel|f:imela} psa.) **I wish I knew.** Z be oboje: **I wish it was warmer.** **I wish it were warmer.** **could**: **I wish I could swim.**

**wish** + **had** + deležnik za to, kar ti je žal za takrat: **I wish I'd listened.** (Ko bi le takrat {m:poslušal|f:poslušala}.) **I wish I hadn't sold the van.** Slovenščina reče obakrat *ko bi le*, angleščina loči.

**wish** + **would** za to, kar naj nekdo ali nekaj stori, ne za stanje: **I wish it would stop raining.** **I wish you wouldn't shout.** Zase **could**.

**if only** je močnejše, časi so isti: **If only I knew!** **If only I'd known!** **If only it would stop!**

**hope** je za to, kar se še lahko zgodi, običajno s sedanjikom: **I hope it stops raining.**

V govoru ljudje rečejo tudi *I wish I'd have known*. Pisno velja **I wish I had known**. *I wish I would have known* je pogost spodrsljaj.
rule.de:
**wish** + Vergangenheit für das, was jetzt nicht so ist: **I wish I had a dog.** (Ich wünschte, ich hätte einen Hund.) **I wish I knew.** Bei be beides: **I wish it was warmer.** **I wish it were warmer.** **could**: **I wish I could swim.**

**wish** + **had** + Partizip für das, was dir von damals leidtut: **I wish I'd listened.** (Ich wünschte, ich hätte zugehört.) **I wish I hadn't sold the van.**

**wish** + **would** für das, was jemand oder etwas tun soll, nicht für einen Zustand: **I wish it would stop raining.** **I wish you wouldn't shout.** Für dich selbst **could**.

**if only** ist stärker, die Zeiten sind dieselben: **If only I knew!** **If only I'd known!** **If only it would stop!**

**hope** ist für das, was noch geschehen kann, meist mit dem Präsens: **I hope it stops raining.**

Gesprochen sagt man auch *I wish I'd have known*. Geschrieben gilt **I wish I had known**. *I wish I would have known* ist ein häufiger Ausrutscher.
rule.it:
**wish** + il passato per ciò che adesso non è così: **I wish I had a dog.** (Vorrei avere un cane.) **I wish I knew.** Con be tutti e due: **I wish it was warmer.** **I wish it were warmer.** **could**: **I wish I could swim.**

**wish** + **had** + participio per ciò che rimpiangi di allora: **I wish I'd listened.** (Magari avessi ascoltato.) **I wish I hadn't sold the van.**

**wish** + **would** per ciò che qualcuno o qualcosa deve fare, non per uno stato: **I wish it would stop raining.** **I wish you wouldn't shout.** Per te stess{m:o|f:a} **could**.

**if only** è più forte, i tempi sono gli stessi: **If only I knew!** **If only I'd known!** **If only it would stop!**

**hope** è per ciò che può ancora succedere, di solito col presente: **I hope it stops raining.**

A voce si dice anche *I wish I'd have known*. Per iscritto vale **I wish I had known**. *I wish I would have known* è una svista comune.
rule.en:
**wish** + the past for what isn't so now: **I wish I had a dog.** **I wish I knew.** With be, both: **I wish it was warmer.** **I wish it were warmer.** **could**: **I wish I could swim.**

**wish** + **had** + the participle for what you regret about then: **I wish I'd listened.** **I wish I hadn't sold the van.**

**wish** + **would** for what you want someone or something to do, not for how things are: **I wish it would stop raining.** **I wish you wouldn't shout.** For yourself, **could**.

**if only** is stronger, with the same tenses: **If only I knew!** **If only I'd known!** **If only it would stop!**

**hope** is for what may still happen, usually with the present: **I hope it stops raining.**

In talk people also say *I wish I'd have known*. Writing wants **I wish I had known**. *I wish I would have known* is a common slip.

title.it: I wish I had; if only I'd known
title.en: I wish I had; if only I'd known

rule.sl: Zdaj ni tako: **wish** + preteklik: **I wish I had a dog.** Takrat ni bilo: **wish** + **had** + deležnik: **I wish I'd listened.** Naj se spremeni: **wish** + **would**: **I wish it would stop.** **if only** je močnejše, časi isti. Lahko se še zgodi: **I hope it stops.**
rule.de: Jetzt nicht so: **wish** + Vergangenheit: **I wish I had a dog.** Damals nicht: **wish** + **had** + Partizip: **I wish I'd listened.** Es soll anders werden: **wish** + **would**: **I wish it would stop.** **if only** ist stärker, dieselben Zeiten. Kann noch geschehen: **I hope it stops.**
rule.it: Adesso non è così: **wish** + il passato: **I wish I had a dog.** Allora no: **wish** + **had** + participio: **I wish I'd listened.** Deve cambiare: **wish** + **would**: **I wish it would stop.** **if only** è più forte, stessi tempi. Può ancora succedere: **I hope it stops.**
rule.en: Not so now: **wish** + the past: **I wish I had a dog.** Not then: **wish** + **had** + the participle: **I wish I'd listened.** You want it to change: **wish** + **would**: **I wish it would stop.** **if only** is stronger, the same tenses. It may still happen: **I hope it stops.**

examples.en: I wish I knew the way.
examples.de: Ich wünschte, ich wüsste den Weg.

tip.sl: 💡 Slovensko *ko bi le {m:vedel|f:vedela}* je **I wish I knew** (zdaj) ali **I wish I'd known** (takrat).
tip.de: 💡 Deutsch *hätte* ist **had** (**I wish I had**), *hätte gehabt* ist **had had** (**I wish I'd had**).
tip.it: 💡 *Magari sapessi* è **I wish I knew**; *magari avessi saputo* è **I wish I'd known**.
tip.en: 💡 One tense back: now **I wish I knew**, then **I wish I'd known**.
